**Senior Backend Engineer (Go)** — Finora Technologies Sdn Bhd
Kuala Lumpur (Bangsar South) · Hybrid, 3 days in office · RM 11,000–15,000/month
Posted 6 days ago on JobStreet · Fintech (payments infrastructure)

**About the role**
Finora builds payment rails used by 200+ merchants across Malaysia and
Singapore. You'll own core money-movement services end to end.

**Requirements**
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience
- Strong Go in production
- Experience designing and operating gRPC microservices
- Production Kubernetes experience (we run EKS)
- Solid PostgreSQL: schema design, query tuning
- Comfortable with on-call for services you own
- Strong written and spoken English

**Nice to have**
- Payments / fintech domain experience
- AWS certification
- Experience mentoring junior engineers

**What we offer**
- Learning budget (RM 4,000/yr), medical + dental, 18 days leave
- Hybrid work, MacBook, ESOP for senior hires
